questions.question: How connected have you felt to family, friends and crew this week?
How would you rate your overall stress level this week?
How has your mood been on most days?

miniTest.disclaimer: Results are trend data for the medical team, not a diagnosis.
miniTest.idleHint: Run the check to record today's objective baseline.
miniTest.normalText: Reaction time and motor accuracy are within your mission baseline — no objective signs of fatigue.
miniTest.watchText: Slower than your usual baseline. Consider extra rest before your next EVA or heavy task load, and mention it at the next medical check.
miniTest.reactionHow: Tap the lit target as soon as it appears. Five rounds, one average reaction time.
miniTest.traceHow: Drag from left to right and keep the cursor inside the channel. Accuracy is scored automatically.
miniTest.subtitle: Objective measurements alongside your weekly survey — they catch radiation-related brain fatigue that self-reports miss.
miniTest.title: 2-minute cognitive & motor check

recommendations.text: Schedule a private comms window with family or friends this week — protected time with no mission tasks.
recommendations.title: Connect with home

recommendations.text: Two guided breathing sessions per day, 10 minutes each. Pair them with the VR relaxation room.
recommendations.title: Guided breathing protocol

recommendations.text: Shift your light exposure and move your last espresso earlier. The crew medical team can adjust your sleep prescription.
recommendations.title: Sleep schedule reset

recommendations.text: Join the Saturday crew dinner and one shared exercise block — social contact is the strongest buffer in long missions.
recommendations.title: Crew social time

recommendations.text: Add one low-effort walk on the treadmill after dinner. Gentle movement reliably lifts mood within days.
recommendations.title: Movement snack

recommendations.text: Book a private session with the flight surgeon. This is routine support, not an emergency — reaching out early is the protocol.
recommendations.title: Talk to the flight surgeon

resultBands.text: Your indicators look healthy. Keep the current routine of exercise, sleep and crew contact.
resultBands.title: All clear

resultBands.text: A few areas need attention. The recommendations below target exactly those areas — small adjustments usually help within a week.
resultBands.title: Keep an eye on it

resultBands.text: Several indicators are elevated. Please book a private session with the flight surgeon — this is normal practice and completely confidential.
resultBands.title: Talk to the flight surgeon
